bindings.meaning: Exact bijections from every saved source interval to an initial ambient arc and from every final ambient arc to every saved target strand, including ordered endpoint IDs and endpoint vertices.

boundary_components.meaning: Exact connected components of the boundary triangle subcomplex; every component is checked as S2.

arcs.meaning: Pairwise interior-disjoint embedded edge paths. No imported source IDs or route hashes count as paths.

ribbons.meaning: Embedded triangulated disks whose boundary is exactly the core path, push-off path, and two endpoint edges.

fixed_data: Every move fixes the four insertion-boundary components pointwise. Bistellar support must miss every arc/ribbon vertex; ambient isomorphisms must map all typed subcomplexes exactly.
